candidate.answerReason: The three fenced sides give x(20−2x)=48, whose roots are 4 and 6. Their corresponding parallel sides are 12 m and 8 m, both positive.

methods.label: Express the unfixed side using the fence length
methods.explanation: Let the length of the side perpendicular to the wall be \(x\). Then the side parallel to the wall is \(20-2x\), so \(x(20-2x)=48\), \(x^2-10x+24=0\), and \(x=4\) or \(6\). Both values satisfy \(20-2x>0\), so both meet the conditions of the problem.
methods.levelReason: The method models the three fenced sides and solves a Grade 9 quadratic area equation, checking geometric feasibility.
